title: ESTABLISHED AuthorityResolution Coherence Falsification
purpose: Determine whether the native AuthorityResolution representation and V06 consequence path prevent an ESTABLISHED resolution from carrying executable authority while preserving contradictory observations.

condition.resolver_use: same incoherent native resolution supplied at consequence boundary and commit gate

questions: Can the native AuthorityResolution constructor represent this condition as ESTABLISHED?
Does V06 inspect coherence between executable authority and observations?
Can boundary verification pass using only the executable authority?
Can commit verification pass using only the executable authority?
Can the local demo consequence occur while contradictory observations remain present in the supplied ESTABLISHED resolution?
bounded_claim: This test evaluates deterministic local reference-runtime behaviour for an explicitly constructed native AuthorityResolution. It does not establish authenticity, distributed consensus, replica freshness, provenance, or how a production resolver would derive its observations.
